_why: LEVEL 6, THE LAST LINE (NIGHT35 builder A, NIGHT35.md A1, DECIDE35 D-1; GG 2026-10-11: "six levels total", wall riding "a lot more like Lucio" with "arenas, bosses and stages built on wall-running semi-platforming"). A SHORT finale: three wall-ride platforming rooms (x2 RIDE HALL, x3 PILLAR RING, x4 SLALOM) and THE STAG (x6, boss id glacier: its rink is Core/Enemies/Rink28Arena.cs). Every weapon the earlier levels earned, the grapple owned (level 4 on). Generated by Tools/night/gen-n35-finale.cjs through n30-lib / n35a-lib; dressed by dress33.cjs. Pars are estimates until the walk bot's medians. Web coordinates, metres: x east, y up, z SOUTH (the player walks north, -z).
